scope: Public medicinal-chemistry directionality checks for pipeline acceptance; not prospective or independent model-performance validation.

examples.public_context: Lidocaine has well-characterized oxidative metabolism; the acceptance question is whether a scoped steric-shielding hypothesis survives the chemical and alert gates.
examples.claim_limit: Does not claim that the generated shielding analog is known, synthetically preferred, or experimentally more stable; an alternative N-alpha-fluoro hypothesis is generated but rejected by the N-C-halo structural-alert gate.

examples.public_context: O-desmethylvenlafaxine is a characterized human metabolite; the acceptance question is whether an O-dealkylation-blocking hypothesis enters the pool.
examples.claim_limit: Does not claim that O-alpha fluorination is a validated clinical analog or prevents every metabolic route.

examples.public_context: A canonical lipophilic/basic hERG-risk example; the acceptance question is whether an executable phenyl-to-heteroaryl lipophilicity-reduction hypothesis survives the gates.
examples.claim_limit: The generated analog is not fexofenadine and no clinical QT-risk conclusion is made; a separate local C-to-N hypothesis is rejected when it creates a structural alert.

examples.public_context: Phenyl/pyridyl replacement is a common bioisosteric MMP class; equal fixture activity represents project-observed potency preservation.
examples.claim_limit: The equal activities are an acceptance fixture, not literature measurements or independent performance evidence.
